races.name: racingtv.com Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Sheikhnshah
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 161-day break but showed promise on Newcastle debut and hooded first time suggests connections expect improvement.
runners_data.comment: Made a promising debut when third on Tapeta in November; ought to make presence felt
runners_data.spotlight: From a good French family and made a promising debut when third at Newcastle (1m, AW; travelled strongly) in November; hooded for this reappearance outing; ought to make his presence felt.

runners_data.name: Go On Ollie
runners_data.note: Complete unknown making debut for Watson stable with zero recent runners, making any assessment impossible.
runners_data.comment: Seems very unlikely to meet the standard required on this belated debut
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-brother to 5f AW winner Gleaming Arch (RPR 65); dam fourth in 7f maidens (43), half-sister to two sprint winners; seems very unlikely to meet the standard required on this belated debut.

runners_data.name: Regal Desire
runners_data.note: Another debutant for struggling Ellison yard, half-sister to decent winner but trainer form is concerning.
runners_data.comment: Out of a well-connected mare but probably needs to be useful to make a winning debut
runners_data.spotlight: 1,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to UAE 9.5f dirt winner Withering (RPR 109); dam unraced sister to 5.5f-1m winner Predetermined, half-sister to winners Classic Blade (6f 2yo Group 2), Raadobarg (smart 7f-1m) and Captain Dunne (smart 5f); probably needs to be useful to win on debut.

runners_data.name: Song Of The Clouds
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with class edge from Haggas stable, similar going form is positive but needs pace to develop.
runners_data.comment: Did well to take second in 7f newcomers' race at Newbury last month; holds Group 1 entry
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a Listed winner; 15-8, did pretty well to take second in 11-runner newcomers' race at Newbury (7f, good) last month, given she was messed about soon after the start and still looked green; holds a Group 1 entry at Royal Ascot and is evidently held in some regard.

runners_data.name: Mehmas Champion
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from long layoff, showed Group class in Germany but 354 days off track is significant concern.
runners_data.comment: Fourth in last year's German 2,000 Guineas; changed hands for 14,000gns in autumn
runners_data.spotlight: Looked promising on all three starts in Germany last spring, most notably when staying-on fourth in their 2,000 Guineas (1m, good; Group 2); changed hands for 14,000gns in the autumn and was gelded; market helpful on stable debut.

runners_data.name: It's Debatable
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who improved from slow start last time, drop back in trip from 1m2f could suit.
runners_data.comment: Made a fairly encouraging debut last month but others have more pressing claims
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a well-connected US winner; recovered from slow start to make a fairly encouraging debut when sixth at Beverley (1m2f, good) a fortnight ago; can improve but others in this field have more pressing claims.

runners_data.name: Jimmy's Army
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with poor debut form, trainer has small string and horse lacks any obvious appeal.
runners_data.comment: Didn't show enough on last month's debut to be of significant interest here
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a fair 1m winner; didn't show enough when seventh of ten at Southwell (1m, AW) last month to be of significant interest here.

runners_data.name: Master Of Entropy
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner coming off wind operation, showed improvement last time but needs further progress.
runners_data.comment: Placed on last month's reappearance at Newcastle; needs more but still has potential
runners_data.spotlight: Bettered low-key 2yo debut when third on last month's reappearance at Newcastle (1m, AW; first run after wind op); probably needs to take another step forward but has the potential.

runners_data.name: Clova Royale
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who was hopeless on debut in same race where Fozzie ran well, major form concern.
runners_data.comment: Always behind when 250-1 for recent debut at Thirsk (7f)
runners_data.spotlight: Always behind when 250-1 for debut at Thirsk (7f) 19 days ago, a race in which Fozzie finished second.

runners_data.name: Freddie Steady Go
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner switching from National Hunt, disappointing Flat debut and age is against him.
runners_data.comment: Won a bumper last year but made underwhelming start to Flat career 11 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Won a bumper in good style last year but very disappointing on hurdle debut in January and made an underwhelming start to his Flat career last month; remains best watched.

runners_data.name: Fozzie
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form after breakthrough second at Thirsk, gelding operation has clearly helped.
runners_data.comment: Much improved form when close second to useful stablemate at Thirsk (7f) last month
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten on both 2yo starts (7f/6f) but, having been gelded, belied 66-1 odds and showed huge improvement when close second to useful stablemate at Thirsk (7f, good) last month; upped in trip here; shortlisted.

races.paceDynamic: Fozzie is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate a controlled pace from the start, with Sheikhnshah likely to track him in second. The lack of natural pace angles means Fozzie can bowl along at a steady gallop without serious pressure, creating an uncontested lead through the middle stages. With multiple hold-up horses including Mehmas Champion, Song Of The Clouds, and It's Debatable needing to make ground late, this tactical setup clearly favours prominent runners who can sit close to Fozzie and have first run on the turn.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Fozzie gets an easy lead with Sheikhnshah tracking at a respectful distance.
scenarios.body: Fozzie controls the tempo completely and kicks clear in the straight while the hold-up brigade struggle to close the gap on good ground. The prominent duo get first run while the back markers need a pace collapse that won't come.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and the field bunches up approaching the home turn.
scenarios.body: The condensed field allows the class horses Song Of The Clouds and Mehmas Champion to unleash devastating finishing kicks. Haggas and O'Meara's tactical expertise helps their runners time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Sheikhnshah decides to pressure Fozzie early or other prominent runners join the pace battle.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo saps both leaders and creates a tactical meltdown in the final furlong. Hold-up horses like It's Debatable and Master Of Entropy benefit from the pace collapse to pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced newcomers Go On Ollie or Regal Desire show significant improvement from their debuts.
scenarios.body: One of the unknown quantities produces a debut performance well above their shown form. Their fresh legs and unexposed ability catch the more exposed runners off guard.

watchPoints.text: Sheikhnshah's hood first time could indicate significant improvement expected from the Camacho stable after long absence.
Song Of The Clouds may struggle if Fozzie sets genuine fractions, as Haggas filly needs pace to develop her finishing kick.
Mehmas Champion's 354-day layoff is substantial even with Group class, particularly concerning for hold-up type needing sharpness.
Go On Ollie and Regal Desire market moves will reveal stable confidence as both are complete unknowns making debuts.
Fozzie's price will indicate whether connections believe he can follow up his Thirsk breakthrough performance.

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap (Div I)

runners_data.name: One Of Our Own
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with proven C&D form who should get his ideal pace scenario to unleash a strong finish
runners_data.comment: C&D winner who has run two solid races in defeat this year; in the mix once again
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner; two creditable fourth-place finishes this year; likely to give it another good go under suitable conditions.

runners_data.name: Hurstwood
runners_data.note: Front-running veteran with excellent Redcar record but lacks natural speed to dominate throughout
runners_data.comment: Three-time C&D winner; on fair mark and sharper for recent reappearance; shortlisted
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins and a second from nine visits to Redcar; looked as though the run would bring him on when in midfield at Thirsk 19 days ago; more appealing than many.

runners_data.name: Mister Sky Blue
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 142-day break with previous course form and dangerous finishing kick
runners_data.comment: Poor strike-rate but he came to hand early last year and he's on a good mark now; chance
runners_data.spotlight: Just over 12 months since he recorded his only success, namely a 6f handicap at Hamilton (good to firm); that win came off a 6lb higher mark and he was second at Newcastle off 2lb higher in November; absent 142 days but he ran well on last season's return; more appealing than many.

runners_data.name: Night Emperor
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making stable debut for new yard after long absence, hard to assess current ability
runners_data.comment: Low-key stable debut in February (7f, AW; after long absence); not easily recommended
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to progress for Hugo Palmer and he finished well beaten (50-1) on his stable debut in February (7f, AW; after 483 days off); down in grade but not easily recommended.

runners_data.name: Auntie Jo
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare in good form since visor applied, benefits from 7lb claimer and strong trainer record
runners_data.comment: Running well since a visor went on; each-way shout at least with promising claimer booked
runners_data.spotlight: Running well since the visor went on, most recently keeping on for fourth at Doncaster 13 days ago (5f, good to firm); each-way shout with a promising 7lb claimer enlisted.

runners_data.name: Let's Go Hugo
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer better at 5f but has shown C&D ability, disappointing 2026 form a concern
runners_data.comment: All wins at 5f but has run well over C&D; drops in grade and can't be ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: All wins at 5f but he has run well over C&D; yet to shine in 2026 but dropping into 0-55 company will help; not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Due Respect
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with excellent course record who can track the pace and has tactical speed
runners_data.comment: Good course form; sharper for last week's return; appealing claims back at 6f
runners_data.spotlight: Three course runs have yielded a win and two second-place finishes; they came over 7f but she is not short of pace and today's drop in trip could suit; went off too fast on last week's Musselburgh return but she should be sharper here and she's high on the list.

runners_data.name: Indy's Angel
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with low weight but poor recent form makes her hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: Yet to shine in two runs this year; others bring more compelling claims
runners_data.spotlight: Ended her 2025 campaign with a modest effort and she hasn't fired in either run this year; enough to prove for now.

runners_data.name: Canaria Sun
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with blinkers applied, trained by in-form Tim Easterby yard

runners_data.name: Ziva's Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare who was close-up at Doncaster last time, each-way possibility at big odds
runners_data.comment: Exposed 18-race maiden but boasts the odd piece of form that would give her frame claims
runners_data.spotlight: 0-18 but the odd run has hinted at better and she wasn't beaten far on her Doncaster return two weeks ago (5f, good to firm); not a solid option but could sneak into the frame.

runners_data.name: Sadiiki
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning from 142-day layoff with hood first-time, peak form too low
runners_data.comment: Unplaced all nine starts, recording a peak RPR of 44; hard to recommend
runners_data.spotlight: Peak RPR of just 44 in her nine starts; hard to recommend back from a 142-day layoff.

runners_data.name: She's A Dark Horse
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with new headgear after long break, maiden record makes her hard to back
runners_data.comment: Unplaced all 13 starts; new headgear needs to prove transformative
runners_data.spotlight: Modest maiden who has finished unplaced in all 13 starts; new headgear needs to prove transformative.

races.paceDynamic: Hurstwood will set a sustainable pace from the front with Due Respect likely tracking close behind in second, but neither is a confirmed speed merchant so the tempo should be manageable. The lack of natural early speed in this field means the pace will be honest but not searingly quick, allowing the race to develop into a sprint finish from the 2f pole. One Of Our Own, Auntie Jo, and Mister Sky Blue all possess finishing kicks and will benefit from the likely scenario of being within striking distance turning for home. This tactical setup clearly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with a turn of foot over pure front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Kick Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady and the field remains bunched turning in
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with plenty left in the tank for a sustained drive from 2f out. One Of Our Own and Mister Sky Blue can unleash their finishing speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Due Respect or another tracker can position perfectly behind the pace
scenarios.body: The horse tracking Hurstwood gets first run on the leader and has enough pace to repel late challengers. Due Respect's course form and tactical speed become decisive advantages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Hurstwood gets an easy lead and finds extra reserves in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The veteran's course experience pays dividends as he withstands the late charge with determination. His proven stamina over the C&D distance becomes the winning factor.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the headgear changes prove transformative for the outsiders
scenarios.body: Canaria Sun with blinkers or She's A Dark Horse with new headgear find improvement that the market hasn't factored in. The pace scenario suits their running style perfectly.

watchPoints.text: Hurstwood may get too easy a lead early and prove hard to peg back despite lacking natural gate speed
One Of Our Own could be caught flat-footed if the pace quickens suddenly given his hold-up style
Due Respect's visor and course form combination makes her the main pace threat to any leader
Mister Sky Blue returning from 142 days off may need the run despite his obvious class advantage
Watch for Auntie Jo to be produced with a late run down the outside under her 7lb claimer

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap (Div II)

runners_data.name: Starsong
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the likely pace shape, though form has declined since promising Southwell second
runners_data.comment: Multiple winner; went close on her return (6f, AW); less good since but can't discount
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-time winner who was a close second at Southwell on her return to action in March; unable to match that in two runs since but she has too much ability to discount at this level.

runners_data.name: Emerald Army
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs pace to collapse, but showed ability above this level previously
runners_data.comment: Has looked better than this level on occasions; may come on for stable debut; chance
runners_data.spotlight: Mixed bag for his former stable but he looked a cut above this level on occasions; joint-favourite for his stable/seasonal debut at Thirsk 19 days ago and ran on for a never-dangerous fifth; he will need to build on that effort to win here but that is not out of the question.

runners_data.name: Jeany May
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but stamina doubts at 6f and poor recent form is concerning
runners_data.comment: Two uninspiring efforts this year and stamina still to be proven; others are much safer
runners_data.spotlight: Two uninspiring efforts this year and although she is tumbling down the weights, she has a good deal to prove, including stamina.

runners_data.name: Bayraat
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 222 days, has run well fresh but needs slower pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Poor strike-rate but returns at a low level and he has gone well fresh in the past
runners_data.spotlight: Getting on for three years since his sole success (6f, good to firm); thrown in on last year's best form and he has run well fresh in the past; not discounted now dropping into a 0-55.

runners_data.name: Stormy Pearl
runners_data.note: Front runner with C&D win and solid Thirsk second, 7lb apprentice claim is significant positive
runners_data.comment: Promising 2nd at Thirsk on return 19 days ago; good apprentice takes off 7lb; contender
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner; had a few of today's rivals behind her when second of 17 at Thirsk 19 days ago, her first outing since November; promising apprentice takes off 7lb; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: A Lady Forever
runners_data.note: Prominent style could work but 56 days since last run and poor AW form this year
runners_data.comment: Not found her best form so far in 2025; return to turf needs to revive her fortunes
runners_data.spotlight: Bits of form that bring her into the reckoning but she hasn't found her best in three AW runs in 2026; she has shown promise in a handful of turf runs but others appeal more for the win.

runners_data.name: Run This Way
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who needs softer going, current good ground not ideal for her
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; on a dangerous mark but quiet for a while & slower ground ideal; new headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Won three times on good to soft/soft in 2024, the first of them coming over C&D; not at her best for a while now though and she wouldn't want the ground to dry out too much; first-time blinkers replace cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Dunnington Lad
runners_data.note: Lead style but 235 days off and struggled throughout 2025 season
runners_data.comment: 2025 was a struggle and he has plenty to prove back from 235 days off
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over 5f at Ripon in 2024; 2025 was a struggle and, although his mark has bottomed out, he has plenty tot prove on his reappearance.

runners_data.name: Jamie's Choice
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 5lb apprentice claim, but 6f trip is questionable for this 5f specialist
runners_data.comment: It's been a while since she was at her best and 6f is the query today
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over 5f in the summer of 2024, including at this track; ran well on her seasonal return last April but it has been downhill ever since; 6f a query too.

runners_data.name: Barmyblade
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from top yard, showed ability last spring but poor recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Well treated on form from last spring; down in grade and offered a bit more at Catterick
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins on good ground (5f-6f) last spring, the last of them coming off a 4lb higher mark; ended 2025 quietly and yet to find his best in 2026 but there was some encouragement to be gleaned from his latest Catterick fourth; now eligible for 0-55 company and could bounce back to top form.

runners_data.name: Raja Charger
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse dropping in trip significantly, first-time cheekpieces applied but risky profile
runners_data.comment: Poor novice form over further; drop in trip/headgear not enough to tempt
runners_data.spotlight: Poor form in four novice runs from 1m to 1m3f; drops in trip with cheekpieces added; risky.

races.paceDynamic: Stormy Pearl and Dunnington Lad will dispute the early lead, with Stormy Pearl likely to gain control given her superior recent form and the superior rider. The pace should be honest rather than fierce with 11 runners spread across styles, creating a genuine gallop that will test stamina over this 6f trip. Prominent runners like Starsong and Barmyblade can track the pace in ideal positions, while hold-up horses face the challenge of making up ground in a small field. This shape favours prominent racers who can sit close to the pace and quicken, as the early leaders may tire and the hold-up horses lack the cover to mount effective late charges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Stormy Pearl sets honest fractions and begins to tire in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The prominent runners tracking the pace will have first run on the weakening leader and can sustain their challenge to the line. Starsong and Barmyblade are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their class advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Stormy Pearl gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of sustained pace pressure allows the leader to conserve energy and pull away from inferior rivals in the straight. Stormy Pearl's C&D win and recent Thirsk second give her the credentials to execute this.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and the field comes back to the closers in the final 2f
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows patient rides to pay off as hold-up horses find gaps and superior finishing kicks. Emerald Army and Bayraat can benefit from their ability to quicken off slow pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If both Stormy Pearl and Dunnington Lad go too fast and tie up badly
scenarios.body: The entire field converges in a messy finish where any horse getting a clear run can prevail. This chaotic scenario opens the door for outsiders with tactical speed to capitalize on the pace meltdown.

watchPoints.text: Stormy Pearl could get easy lead if Dunnington Lad misses the break after long absence
Watch for Barmyblade showing early tactical speed to get closer to pace than usual style suggests
Emerald Army needs to be held up further back than usual given lack of pace in this small field
Starsong must travel strongly into straight as her recent form suggests stamina limitations
Both apprentice jockeys on Stormy Pearl and Jamie's Choice could impact pace judgment

races.name: Market Cross Jewellers Handicap

runners_data.name: Kitsune Power
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer showing renewed form with two recent thirds, handles good ground well and David Allan's 5lb claim helps significantly at the weights.
runners_data.comment: Finished 3rd in both starts this year; conditions no problem and should be involved again
runners_data.spotlight: It has been nearly two years since the last of his four wins but his two starts in 2026 have seen him finish third; conditions won't be an excuse and he's more solid than some.

runners_data.name: Billy No Mates
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse without a win since September 2023 but Connor Beasley takes off a valuable 7lb, making this a live each-way chance on his best form.
runners_data.comment: Winless since September 2023; chance on last year's best but he is returning from a break
runners_data.spotlight: A veteran who is without a win since September 2023; good weights chance on last season's best but he ended the year with a modest effort; handles good ground but rarely seen on a faster surface.

runners_data.name: Tupero
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner in good current form with a recent second over 1m5f on good ground, well-suited to this trip and Daniel Tudhope is an excellent tactical jockey.

runners_data.name: Grazeon Sunshine
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying top weight but recent form is concerning with two poor efforts, needs significant improvement to feature prominently here.

runners_data.name: Bruce Banner
runners_data.note: Only front runner in the field who should get an uncontested lead, has winning form over similar trips and Hollie Doyle excels in tactical situations.
runners_data.comment: Stretched by 2m last time and this trip should suit; one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: Made all to win a small-field handicap at Newcastle (1m4f, AW) last April off a 2lb higher mark, and made a winning debut over hurdles in November; stayed on for third in a 1m4f handicap at Newcastle in March (visored first time) but looked stretched by 2m latest; this trip should be in range and he can't be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Coverbridge
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer stepping up markedly in distance with generally modest form for current connections, needs to prove stamina at this extended trip.
runners_data.comment: Struggled since joining current stable and steps up markedly in trip with a point to prove
runners_data.spotlight: 7f AW win as a 2yo for Philip Makin; generally struggled for current stable though and steps up markedly in distance with a point to prove.

races.paceDynamic: Bruce Banner is the only confirmed front runner in this small field and should get an uncontested lead, allowing him to dictate a steady, sustainable gallop over this stamina-testing 1m6f trip. With all other runners showing hold-up tendencies, there will be minimal early pressure, creating a race where the pace could become quite pedestrian. The tactical battle will unfold in the final 3-4 furlongs as the hold-up horses try to reel in Bruce Banner's advantage. This race shape strongly favours the front runner who can control the tempo and kick clear when the field closes, making prominent runners with tactical speed the profile to follow.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Bruce Banner gets soft fractions and kicks clear 2f out
scenarios.body: He controls every call under Hollie Doyle's patient ride, then quickens decisively when the closers launch their challenge. His stamina advantage and tactical position prove decisive over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and suits a strong finisher
scenarios.body: The pedestrian early gallop sets up perfectly for a horse with a devastating turn of foot to sweep past Bruce Banner in the final furlong. Kitsune Power's recent third-place efforts suggest he's primed for this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Bruce Banner simultaneously from 3f out
scenarios.body: The front runner faces pressure from several angles as Tupero, Kitsune Power and Billy No Mates all mount challenges, creating a tactical dogfight. The horse who times their run perfectly through the sustained drive benefits most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Bruce Banner stops dramatically and the field closes late
scenarios.body: The leader's stamina gives way dramatically in the final 2f after dictating throughout, allowing a deep closer like Grazeon Sunshine to emerge from the pack. This chaotic finish rewards patient tactics and strong staying power.

watchPoints.text: Bruce Banner getting too much rope early - if he's allowed to bowl along unchallenged, his front-running advantage becomes overwhelming
Kitsune Power's position turning for home - his recent thirds suggest he's close to a win and David Allan's claim makes him very dangerous
Tupero's tactical placement - fresh from a good second just 2 days ago and Daniel Tudhope will have him perfectly positioned for his challenge
The pace through the first mile - if it's genuinely strong, it could set up the back markers perfectly for the extended finish
Billy No Mates early in the straight - veteran knows how to win and the 7lb claim from Connor Beasley gives him a genuine chance

runners_data.name: Vince Le Prince

runners_data.name: Tropez Power
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning fitter but concerning 0-5 record for current stable despite ability
runners_data.comment: Sole turf success back in 2021 and two years since latest AW win; sixth on reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Gained sole turf success in 2021 and it's two years since last AW win; 0-5 for current stable but he could strip fitter for his Beverley reappearance a fortnight ago.

runners_data.name: Singoura
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare needing significant pace help and clear passage from congested field
runners_data.comment: Latest Doncaster fourth was creditable but took handicap record to 0-8
runners_data.spotlight: AW winner as a juvenile but has drawn a blank in eight handicaps since; latest fourth of 16 at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) was creditable but underlines she needs a bit more from this mark.

runners_data.name: Mayo County
runners_data.note: Previous C&D winner who ran well behind Looks Fantastic last time, suits prominent tactics
runners_data.comment: C&D win last May and third to Looks Fantastic here last month; enters calculations
runners_data.spotlight: Won over C&D (good to firm) off 1lb higher last May and made a positive return to turf when third of 14 to the reopposing Looks Fantastic over C&D (good to firm again) 17 days ago, faring best of three who came towards the stands' side; has to enter calculations.

runners_data.name: Lord Capulet
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner with 5lb claimer benefit, must avoid going too fast early
runners_data.comment: Improver on AW this year, winning four times; claims if he can translate it to turf
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner who landed his fourth 7f Newcastle success of the year when seeing off 13 rivals last month; his 2lb nudge for that is offset by his rider's claim; 0-4 on turf but probably a bit premature to suggest he won't prove fully effective on the grass.

runners_data.name: Yafaarr
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer struggling on turf return but 2lb drop could help his chances
runners_data.comment: In decent nick on AW in second half of 2025 but not in quite same form on turf this spring
runners_data.spotlight: In decent nick on AW for this yard in the second half of 2025 but hasn't been able to translate that to turf on return this spring; being eased 2lb can only help but others are more persuasive.

runners_data.name: Front Gunner
runners_data.note: Prominent runner for new stable with tongue-tie first time, recent 1m may have stretched him
runners_data.comment: Faded over 1m on Saturday; changed yard since and new yard fit tongue-tie; C&D winner
runners_data.spotlight: Possibly stretched by 1m when sixth of nine back on turf at Thirsk last weekend (final start for Stephen Hanlon); new stable is quick to fit him with a tongue-tie and send him back to scene of his only turf win (on good to firm last summer); due to be 2lb lower from the weekend but still worth a betting check.

runners_data.name: Looks Fantastic
runners_data.note: Last-start C&D winner who can sit prominent and has excellent recent form momentum
runners_data.comment: 3lb rise for recent C&D wins looks fair given they were quite well strung out in behind
runners_data.spotlight: Built on an encouraging AW reappearance when gaining a breakthrough win in 14-runner C&D handicap (good to firm; Mayo County third) 17 days ago; they were quite well strung out in behind (over 4l back to the fourth) so a 3lb rise looks manageable.

runners_data.name: The New Bay Pearl
runners_data.note: Hold-up type making stable debut after disappointing for previous yard, hard to trust
runners_data.comment: 0-8 for Roger Varian and well held on recent return for new stable
runners_data.spotlight: 0-8 for Roger Varian and well held on 7f Doncaster reappearance for new yard 13 days ago; can only watch.

runners_data.name: Palmarian
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with headgear change but showed little promise in recent stable debut efforts
runners_data.comment: No obvious promise in two runs for new yard last month
runners_data.spotlight: Capable of fair form but he failed to go on for John and Thady Gosden last season and didn't offer obvious promise in two outings for this yard last month.

races.paceDynamic: Lord Capulet will dictate from the front as the sole confirmed leader, likely uncontested through the early stages given his strong front-running record at 7f. Behind him, Vince Le Prince, Tropez Power, Mayo County, Front Gunner, and Looks Fantastic will create a packed prominent group, with potential for traffic problems turning for home. The hold-up contingent of Singoura, Yafaarr, The New Bay Pearl, and Palmarian will need luck in running from what could become a messy finish. This pace setup strongly favours prominent runners who can position close to Lord Capulet without getting trapped in the mid-pack scrum.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pounce Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Capulet sets sustainable fractions and the prominent pack gets clean runs
scenarios.body: The leaders come clear in the straight without excessive early pace, allowing those tracking to strike with better finishing kicks. Vince Le Prince and Looks Fantastic benefit from their proven 7f form and ability to sit handy.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds Sway
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Capulet gets soft sectionals and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: His class advantage tells when not pressured early, maintaining enough for the drive despite the 5lb claimer. The prominent pack arrives too late having given him too much rope through moderate fractions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates a traffic nightmare 2f out
scenarios.body: Pace collapse allows the patient hold-up horses to weave through and finish strongest. Yafaarr and Singoura benefit from cleaner passages while the leaders tire from battling.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Capulet goes too fast trying to kill off the prominent brigade
scenarios.body: Everyone comes back to the field in a sprint finish where experience and recent form matter most. Mayo County's C&D knowledge and Front Gunner's new stable boost become decisive factors.

watchPoints.text: Lord Capulet setting fractions - if he goes too keen early trying to burn off the prominent pack, he'll set up the race for closers
Traffic developing 3f out when Vince Le Prince, Mayo County, Tropez Power, and Front Gunner all converge behind the leader
Looks Fantastic getting squeezed in the prominent pack given his proven finishing kick needs room to be effective
Yafaarr and Singoura staying patient early - they need the pace to collapse to have any realistic winning chance
Front Gunner adapting to new stable tactics with tongue-tie first time after stable switch from Stephen Hanlon

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap

runners_data.name: El Matador
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with Hollie Doyle aboard who was coming with a strong late run over 7f last time before the line came too soon
runners_data.comment: Narrowly denied on 7f AW return last week and out again before 3lb rise kicks in
runners_data.spotlight: This low-mileage 4yo found the line coming a few strides too soon when odds-on favourite for his 7f Lingfield (AW) reappearance ten days ago; that points to this return to 1m suiting one who is back out a couple of days before a 3lb rise for Lingfield takes effect; his turf wins last year came on good to firm and good; should go well.

runners_data.name: Ron O
runners_data.note: Long-absent hold-up horse returning after 257 days but has strong C&D form and useful handicap record for Ray Craggs
runners_data.comment: Very useful at his best and reduced mark to work with now back with his owner-trainer
runners_data.spotlight: Developed into a very useful handicapper for Ray Craggs in 2024, including a C&D win on good to firm; failed to scale the same heights for David Thompson in 2025 but has a reduced mark to work with now back under the care of his owner.

runners_data.name: Real Gain
runners_data.note: Prominent racer stepping down in class with good recent form who should get an ideal position tracking the leader
runners_data.comment: Added to solid record fresh when fourth at Newmarket for new yard; needs to back it up
runners_data.spotlight: Very useful for Richard Hughes, including third in the Golden Mile at Goodwood (1m, soft) on last year's reappearance; failed to back that up in two subsequent outings in 2025 but added to his solid record fresh when fourth on 1m Newmarket return for new yard 23 days ago; classy but needs to show he can still string good efforts together now.

runners_data.name: Mr King
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after a long break with concerning form including a refusal and tendency to fade in the finish
runners_data.comment: Talented but went 0-14 for Iain Jardine, including refusing to race; new yard tries a hood
runners_data.spotlight: Successful twice (1m2f/1m) in Ireland earlier in his career; talented but failed to win in 14 starts for Iain Jardine, including refusing to race on his penultimate outing last year; it's possible a change of stable (same owner) could spark a revival but a watching brief is still the percentage call here; hooded first time.

runners_data.name: Mr Mistoffelees
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in first-time blinkers who has a poor strike-rate but showed good form at Newcastle last backend
runners_data.comment: Has poor 2-30 strike-rate and not at his best on reappearance; others more obvious
runners_data.spotlight: In good form in blinkers towards the end of last year, winning at Newcastle (1m, AW) in October; however, he has a poor strike-rate and wasn't at his best in cheekpieces at Newcastle (1m, AW) six weeks ago following a break; cheekpieces remain on today.

runners_data.name: Double Parked
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who has excellent C&D record with two wins here last season and should appreciate the return
runners_data.comment: Dual C&D winner last summer and likely needed last month's reappearance here
runners_data.spotlight: This C&D brought out the best in him last season, with two wins in the summer (good to soft/good to firm) and a close third of 13 in the autumn; faded as if needing his reappearance back here 17 days ago and ought to be sharper now.

runners_data.name: Nyman
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in first-time cheekpieces who won well at Newmarket last autumn and has been running respectably this season
runners_data.comment: Won at Newmarket last autumn and two respectable comeback runs this spring; hood refitted
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish 4yo whose came good at the second attempt for Roger Fell in 7f Newmarket handicap (good to soft) last backend; has returned with respectable efforts on AW and turf in recent months and now only 1lb above the mark he defied at Newmarket; cheekpieces are refitted for the first time in Britain.

runners_data.name: Rainbow Nebula
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in first-time visor whose poor reappearance run makes no sense given his progressive profile last autumn
runners_data.comment: Disappointed on reappearance but made steady progress late last year; could bounce back
runners_data.spotlight: Made steady progress switched to handicaps last autumn, winning over 7f at Ascot (good to soft) and 1m at Newcastle (AW); that makes his reappearance effort in the Doncaster Spring Mile disappointing but last year's exploits show he's better than that.

runners_data.name: Two B Tanned
runners_data.note: Front-running specialist with 5lb claimer aboard who won easily at Musselburgh last time and should get an uncontested lead
runners_data.comment: Bolted up on 1m Musselburgh reappearance and 9lb well in compared to future mark
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner who won five times last April-July (good/good to firm) and took it up another notch with easy all-the-way win in 13-runner Musselburgh handicap (1m, good) under Tom Kiely-Marshall on reappearance 11 days ago; that was an apprentice race so she escapes a penalty and is 9lb well in compared to her future mark.

races.paceDynamic: Two B Tanned will take them along from the front with Real Gain, Double Parked, and Nyman likely to race prominently behind him. With only one confirmed front-runner, Two B Tanned can dictate a comfortable tempo without early pressure, allowing him to save energy for the finish. The majority of the field (El Matador, Ron O, Mr King, Mr Mistoffelees, Rainbow Nebula) are hold-up horses who will need the pace to collapse. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Two B Tanned gets an uncontested lead and sustains his gallop
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter controls the tempo perfectly and has enough left to repel late challenges, with prominent racers filling the places. The hold-up brigade gets there too late after fighting for racing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Real Gain or Double Parked can track Two B Tanned and outkick him late
scenarios.body: The front-runner does the donkey work but gets passed in the final furlong by a horse with superior class ratings who travelled well in behind. Two B Tanned still runs a big race for minor honours.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and El Matador or Ron O gets a clear run
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the classier hold-up horses to unleash their superior RPR ratings with a telling late surge. Hollie Doyle's timing on El Matador or Ron O's return to form proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Two B Tanned goes too fast early or ties up dramatically
scenarios.body: The front-runner cracks badly leaving the race wide open for any horse with a clear passage. Rainbow Nebula's class or Mr Mistoffelees' Newcastle form could emerge from the pack.

watchPoints.text: Two B Tanned could get away with murder on the lead if no other horse goes forward early to apply pressure
The hold-up horses El Matador, Ron O, Mr King, Mr Mistoffelees and Rainbow Nebula may struggle for clear runs in the straight
Real Gain and Double Parked need to position themselves close enough to Two B Tanned to strike when the pace lifts
Mr King has shown a tendency to refuse and fade badly so any market support would be concerning
Tom Kiely-Marshall's 5lb claim could be crucial for Two B Tanned in a competitive handicap like this

races.name: Marske Fabrication & Engineering Handicap (Marske Fabrication & Engineeriing Straight Mile Qual')

runners_data.name: King Of Yorkshire
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 171-day break with breeding suggesting improvement possible, but needs to find significant progress from poor juvenile form
runners_data.comment: Well held in three novices last autumn but possible improver in handicaps; check betting
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field in three 7f novice runs last autumn but the fact he's a half-brother to useful winners in France and the US marks him down as a potential improver in low-level handicaps; one to keep an eye on in the betting.

runners_data.name: Very Demure
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the pace setup and showed clear improvement when switched to turf with first-time cheekpieces last month
runners_data.comment: First turf start when second over 1m at Yarmouth in cheekpieces latest; claims
runners_data.spotlight: No impact on AW on first five starts but better signs switched to turf last month, finishing 1l second of nine at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) in first-time cheekpieces (retained); enters calculations off an unchanged mark.

runners_data.name: Harswell River
runners_data.note: Front-runner with proven course form but poor recent effort at Wetherby raises stamina concerns despite the strong early pace she'll help create
runners_data.comment: Well held at Wetherby latest but two C&D outings have yielded a win and third
runners_data.spotlight: Ran poorly at Wetherby only 11 days ago but her two best RPRs have come over this C&D, namely a win on good to soft last year and a third on good to firm last month.

runners_data.name: Give Me Sun
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse facing a tactical disadvantage against the strong pace, with little evidence of ability to suggest she can overcome the trip
runners_data.comment: Well held on 7f handicap debut/reappearance; can only watch after that
runners_data.spotlight: Cut little ice in three 7f maidens at 2yrs and similar story in 7f Leicester handicap on reappearance; early days but hard to make a case for based on what she's done so far.

runners_data.name: Lope Y Linda
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with course experience who showed signs of life last week and should benefit from that fitness run
runners_data.comment: Poor form but is entitled to come on for last week's C&D reappearance fifth
runners_data.spotlight: Poor form, although she did make some late gains for fifth on last week's C&D reappearance (good to firm) and may come on for the outing.

runners_data.name: Mohmentous
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in great form after impressive Bath win but needs the pace to collapse to get his ideal race setup
runners_data.comment: Came clear in 1m Bath handicap last week and well treated under a penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Much improved tackling turf for the first time when drawing nearly 4l clear in 1m Bath handicap (firm) last Wednesday; well treated under a 6lb penalty.

runners_data.name: Baldosa
runners_data.note: Hold-up style worked well at Newcastle but struggles to make an impact on turf, particularly over this extended trip
runners_data.comment: Good third on AW in March but well held over 6f and 7f on turf since
runners_data.spotlight: Enters calculations on her solid 6f Newcastle third in March but well held over 6f/7f on turf since; it remains to be seen whether the step up to 1m makes a difference.

runners_data.name: Battenburg Belle
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who showed promise at 6f but has fading tendencies that the strong pace will likely expose over this longer trip
runners_data.comment: Third on 6f handicap debut last month but need to forgive lesser run over C&D since
runners_data.spotlight: Kept on well for close third of 14 on handicap debut at Pontefract (6f, good to soft) last month but never involved when stepped up to 1m here since.

runners_data.name: Leysthorpe Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor form and fading tendencies, making the strong pace scenario particularly challenging for her chances
runners_data.comment: Little form of worth, including well held on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to achieve much of worth, including always in rear on 1m Ripon handicap debut three weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Muvable
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with minimal ability and fading issues, facing an impossible task against this field and pace setup
runners_data.comment: Well held on 6f course reappearance and remains to be seen whether longer trip helps
runners_data.spotlight: Showed little in three runs last term and fared no better for a switch to handicaps with cheekpieces added when last of seven on 6f course reappearance (good to firm) 17 days ago; it remains to be seen whether a 2f longer trip makes any difference.

runners_data.name: A Boy Named Mary
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from long break who will ensure honest gallop but apprentice jockey and poor recent form are concerns
runners_data.comment: Failed to make an impact last year, including a 6f nursery; improvement needed
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to make an impact last year, including last of seven on 6f Newcastle nursery debut in December; steps back up in trip on return; improvement will be needed.

races.paceDynamic: A Boy Named Mary and Harswell River will ensure a genuine gallop from the outset, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead over this straight mile. The honest pace they set will create a searching test of stamina, particularly given the flat nature of Redcar's straight course which offers no respite. Very Demure and Lope Y Linda sitting prominent should get ideal trips tracking the leaders, while the hold-up horses face the challenge of making up ground against a strong pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can sit close to the pace and kick when it matters, as the genuine gallop will likely find out the front-runners and make life difficult for those coming from too far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Very Demure or Lope Y Linda can track the pace-setters without getting embroiled in their battle...
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop will soften up A Boy Named Mary and Harswell River, allowing the prominent racers to strike with superior finishing kicks. Very Demure's recent turf improvement and Lope Y Linda's course familiarity make them ideally positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If either A Boy Named Mary or Harswell River can shake off their rival and dictate terms alone...
scenarios.body: The survivor gets an uncontested lead and can control the tempo to suit their stamina reserves. Harswell River's proven course form gives her the edge if she can break clear of A Boy Named Mary early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes truly unsustainable between the two leaders...
scenarios.body: The front-runners will tie up badly in the final furlong, allowing a closer with tactical speed to sweep past. Mohmentous's recent Bath win suggests he has the finishing kick to capitalize on a collapse up front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Yorkshire shows the improvement his breeding suggests is possible...
scenarios.body: His prominent style gets him into the perfect striking position behind the battling leaders, and any step forward from his juvenile form could be enough. The long absence might have done him good with trainer Jedd O'Keeffe patient in his development.

watchPoints.text: Watch if A Boy Named Mary and Harswell River engage in a prolonged speed duel from flagfall as both have the pace to kill each other off
Watch Very Demure's position turning for home as she needs to be close enough to strike but not caught up in the early battle
Watch for any market moves on King Of Yorkshire given his long absence and potential for improvement from new connections
Watch Mohmentous early as he needs to be closer than usual to the pace given how strong it will be from the start
Watch the opening exchanges to see if either front-runner can gain a tactical advantage and avoid the speed duel

races.name: Watch Race Replays At racingtv.com Handicap

runners_data.name: Powernap
runners_data.note: Hold-up style from wide draw could avoid traffic but 191 days off is a concern
runners_data.comment: Best effort last year when third in 5f course nursery; has been off for 191 days
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort as a juvenile came when third of eight over 5f here (good) last autumn but she failed to back it up when a well-held fourth of five over 6f at Catterick on her final start; off for 191 days.

runners_data.name: Ganthorpe
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with 7lb claimer but poor strike rate suggests limited ability
runners_data.comment: 0-8 but has shown a few times he can be very competitive from a low mark, including latest
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-race maiden but his 1l third of eight at Wolverhampton (6f) in February shows he can be competitive from a basement mark; also a respectable fifth of 15 over 6f at Nottingham (good) 11 days ago; unlikely to be far away.

runners_data.name: Noble Gentleman
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but recent Nottingham form with Hares Bredth was moderate
runners_data.comment: Late headway for eighth of 15 on handicap debut; cheekpieces may sharpen him up
runners_data.spotlight: Off the bridle in rear from an early stage but did make some late headway when 4l eighth of 15 on 6f Nottingham handicap debut 11 days ago, with the reopposing Ganthorpe just over 1l ahead in fifth; improvement possible if today's first-time cheekpieces help him to travel with more fluency.

runners_data.name: The Floors Munky
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 3lb claimer but weak form across all three starts
runners_data.comment: Well held on all three starts but has more realistic chance in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Well held on all three starts (trained by Iain Jardine on debut) but low-grade handicaps provide him with a more realistic chance.

runners_data.name: Miss Magic Dragon
runners_data.note: Won last time at Bath but 6lb penalty and prominent style faces traffic danger
runners_data.comment: Shaded a tight finish at Bath on Monday and claims under penalty turned out again quickly
runners_data.spotlight: Improved at the second time of asking in handicaps when shading a tight finish over the extended 5f at Bath (good) on Monday; not obviously well treated under a 6lb penalty turned out again quickly but the fact she's a winner counts for plenty at this level.

runners_data.name: Hares Bredth
runners_data.note: Prominent style into heavy congestion, strip fitter but faces tactical disadvantage
runners_data.comment: Well-held fourth on 6f Ripon reappearance and Long Shot more obvious of yard's pair
runners_data.spotlight: Five-raced maiden who was a well-held fourth on his 6f Ripon reappearance 12 days ago; may strip fitter but Long Shot is the more obvious of the Tim Easterby pair.

runners_data.name: I'm Dan Dare
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with first-time cheekpieces but poor recent Nottingham form
runners_data.comment: Well held on 5f Nottingham handicap debut/return; cheekpieces need to spark improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Moderate form in three qualifying runs at the end of last year and well held on 5f Nottingham handicap debut and reappearance 19 days ago; first-time cheekpieces need to spark improvement.

runners_data.name: Long Shot
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with cheekpieces retained, good C&D third suggests improvement coming
runners_data.comment: Good third on C&D reappearance and entitled to come on for the outing; player
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort when third of eight on C&D reappearance (good to firm) with cheekpieces added (retained) 17 days ago; entitled to come on for the outing and one of the more likely types.

runners_data.name: Dream Forever
runners_data.note: Hold-up style from high draw (15) provides tactical advantage, AW form solid
runners_data.comment: Reached frame in AW handicaps first two runs this year and poor draw back on turf since
runners_data.spotlight: Reached the frame in 6f/7f handicaps at Newcastle this year; beaten a long way on all three outings on turf, although the outside stall provides an excuse for his heavy defeat in a big-field handicap at Pontefract last month.

runners_data.name: Woody Y Fernandez
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 7lb claimer, placed form for previous trainer shows ability
runners_data.comment: Placed on five of 11 starts, including on AW stable debut; ought to be competitive
runners_data.spotlight: Placed a few times for Jennie Candlish, including on turf, and again when third of eight on 6f Wolverhampton stable debut 37 days ago; ought to be competitive.

runners_data.name: Brain Freeze
runners_data.note: Prominent style with blinkers but no improvement shown in recent nurseries
runners_data.comment: Well held all three handicaps, including reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: No improvement for the switch to nurseries on turf last autumn and weakened to finish well held on AW reappearance 24 days ago; others are more persuasive.

runners_data.name: Kwidsin
runners_data.note: Prominent runner reverting to sprint trip but fading tendency is concerning
runners_data.comment: Yet to build on debut, although he might have needed outing on handicap debut/return
runners_data.spotlight: Has yet to build on last summer's 7f Musselburgh debut but it's possible his 7f Southwell handicap debut and reappearance six weeks ago was needed; reverts to sprinting now.

runners_data.name: Charcon
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with first-time visor after 82 days, needs headgear to spark improvement
runners_data.comment: Poor form so far and first-time visor needs to spark improvement back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Only poor form shown to date, including two AW handicaps this winter; a first-time visor needs to spark improvement back on turf after 12 weeks off.

runners_data.name: Monk's Hill
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner drops to 6f with tongue-tie, uncontested lead is huge tactical advantage
runners_data.comment: Led for long way over 7f on AW last week so return to 6f could be good move; tongue-tie on
runners_data.spotlight: 0-8 but mainly over 7f/1m and she shaped as if the drop back to 6f may suit when fourth of 12 over 7f at Wolverhampton ten days ago, leading until inside the final furlong; also equipped with a first-time tongue-tie; gets the vote.

runners_data.name: Auspicious
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with 3lb claimer, got off mark at Newcastle but moderate recent form
runners_data.comment: One of only two winners in the line-up but only a well-held fifth over C&D latest
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark on his nursery debut at Newcastle (6f, AW) last September; creditable third there (6f again) in March but only fifth (Long Shot 5l ahead in third) back on turf here 17 days ago.

races.paceDynamic: Monk's Hill is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 15-runner field and should get an uncontested lead, creating a sustainable pace scenario. Six horses (Miss Magic Dragon, Hares Bredth, The Floors Munky, Woody Y Fernandez, Brain Freeze, Kwidsin) want prominent positions, guaranteeing congestion and traffic problems turning for home. With 9 hold-up horses squeezed into a narrow window behind the early pace battle, this becomes a positioning nightmare 2-3 furlongs out. This race shape heavily favors the lone leader Monk's Hill and any hold-up horses drawn wide who can avoid the midfield carnage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Monk's Hill gets clear early fractions without pressure from the prominent brigade
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter builds an insurmountable advantage while the field gets snarled up behind the early pace battle. Hold-up horses struggle to weave through the traffic created by 6 prominent runners fighting for position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Traffic Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group creates severe interference 2f out, opening gaps for closers
scenarios.body: Wide-drawn hold-up horses like Powernap and Auspicious get clear runs while others are trapped behind the pace melee. The sustained gallop suits horses finishing from off the pace with room to maneuver.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Magic Dragon and Woody Y Fernandez pressure Monk's Hill into unsustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes too strong, setting up a collapse scenario where all early leaders tire. Fresh hold-up horses inherit the race despite the tactical disadvantage of the race shape.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Draw Advantage Decisive
scenarios.trigger: If the high-drawn runners get tactical positioning advantages in the prominent scrum
scenarios.body: Horses drawn in double digits avoid early interference and can dictate their own race position. The wide berths allow prominent runners to maintain momentum without getting caught in traffic.

watchPoints.text: Monk's Hill must be backed to get clear early fractions - any pressure from Miss Magic Dragon or Woody Y Fernandez destroys the pace scenario
Traffic chaos inevitable 2f out when 6 prominent runners hit the wall simultaneously - watch for hold-up horses with clear runs
Long Shot and Dream Forever drawn widest of the hold-up brigade - positioning will determine if they can capitalize on the pace setup
First-time headgear on I'm Dan Dare (cheekpieces) and Charcon (visor) could spark improvement from their poor recent form
Miss Magic Dragon carries 6lb penalty from Bath win into traffic nightmare - weight and tactics both against her
